messages:
pagerduty-bot: [AUTO PAGE] svc-inference-usw2 error-rate spike: 5xx rate 7.8% over 5m (> alert threshold). PD: #INC-48291. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-48291
incident-bot: alert metadata: cluster=usw2, route=inference-gateway, sample=502, top-affected-customer=acme-corp (20% of their requests).
lee: acked in PD. I’m on it. jumping into logs now. :running:
maria: oncall handoff: I’ll pair with lee for any routing changes. tagging sam for next rotation. @sam FYI you’ll take H+2 if we don’t resolve.
sam: thx. watching metrics, looks like a single node group in usw2 is spiking CPU/io, requests queued -> 502.
raj: quick question — any deploys in the last 30m? I don’t see active rollouts.
lee: no deploys. seeing repetitive kvcache evictions on proxy-2-3. snippet: ```ERROR kv_cache: evict loop; entries=128k; latency=120ms; upstream=502```
alex: customer impact check — Acme reports 20% error rate, other customers minimal. SLA risk: low-medium. recommend mitigation: route 15% traffic to fallback pool + scale up nodes.
maria: applying routing change now: `invctl routing set-weight --route inference-gateway --to fallback-usw2 --weight 15%`
incident-bot: routing change queued. executing canary (5% -> 15%) with 30s drain.
pagerduty-bot: PD note: Lee acknowledged at 1859994340. Escalation timer set to 20m.
sam: manual scale initiated: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-inference-usw2 --size=12` (was 8). watching warmup.
lee: after initial shift to fallback, 5xx rate dropped from 7.8% -> 2.1% in 2m. continuing to monitor. :white_check_mark:
raj: good. can we also enable prefix KV cache warmup to reduce evictions? command: `kvcachectl preheat --cluster usw2 --prefix /user/`
alex: do it, but low risk for further instability. also opening incident tracker: https://tracker.example/incidents/48291 (owner=lee)
maria: note to support: pinged account team for Acme with initial message. template used: "We’re investigating elevated 5xx errors in US-WEST2, mitigation in progress; will update in 15m."
incident-bot: monitoring: error-rate=2.0% (now), cpu=78%, kv_evictions=down 60%. next check in 5m.
sam: planning next steps: if stable <1% for 10m, scale back and close PD. otherwise investigate root cause of kv eviction pattern overnight.
lee: agreed. handing off incident to sam at H+10m for night coverage. I’ll write a short post-incident note.
pagerduty-bot: PD update: incident status -> acknowledged, responders updated, escalation paused.
alex: thanks team. keep thread updated if regressions.
lee: closing updates here — final status at 1859994622: error-rate stabilized at 0.9%, fallback routing removed, autoscale left at +4 nodes for 30m cooldown. follow-up: postmortem to include kvcache tuning and probe that caused spike. :memo:
